description: This file contains a C++ demonstration of thread synchronization using semaphores in the Zephyr RTOS environment. It defines semaphore classes, creates threads, and manages inter-thread communication with print statements.

classes.name: semaphore
classes.description: Abstract base class for semaphore implementations with pure virtual methods.

classes.name: cpp_semaphore
classes.description: Concrete semaphore class implementing semaphore behavior using Zephyr kernel semaphores.

methods.name: cpp_semaphore::wait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely for the semaphore to be signaled.

methods.name: cpp_semaphore::wait
methods.description: Waits for the semaphore with a specified timeout.

methods.name: coop_thread_entry
methods.description: Thread function managing cooperative thread behavior, printing messages, and synchronizing with main thread.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function creating threads, printing messages, and coordinating with the cooperative thread.
